parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) A stationary object is acted upon by a number of forces. State the conditions which must be true if the object

ms.label: 3(a)(i)
ms.text: No resultant force / net force OR Forces are balanced OR Forces in opposite directions are equal OR Forces cancel

ms.text:
no resultant / net moment / torque / turning effect
OR (Sum of) clockwise moments = (sum of) anticlockwise moments
